attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) to boot with audit=1 persistently by patching both /etc/default/grub and the overriding /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg (cloud image grub.d snippet sources after and overwrites GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT), regenerated grub.cfg via update-grub, then rebooted the node and verified the running kernel booted with audit=1 and audit subsystem enabled.
